ui.title: THE HOLLOWMERE SECRET
ui.quitConfirm: Leave the case? Your progress will be lost.
ui.useHint: Open your Casebook, pick an item and tap Hold.
emptyCan: The can is empty. Fill it first.
hint1: Psst. Look over there. Something is waiting.
hintNone: I'm out of ideas. You're on your own, detective.
idle: Try turning around. Drag to look around.
ui.rubbingHint: Drag the charcoal across the paper
ui.tilesHint: Tap the next tile. Up, down, left or right only.
ui.corkHint: Tap one card, then the card it leads to.
ui.jigHint: Drag each torn piece to the slot with the same number. Or tap a piece, then tap its slot.
ui.accuseHint: Who rang the bell early? Check your notes.
ui.marksHint: In which order do the four Marks go?
ui.organHint: Play the lullaby on the organ.
ui.leverHint: Pull exactly three times. Reach the red line.
ui.winLine: You are now an Honorary Warden of Hollowmere.
ui.loseLine: Midnight passes and Ines slips out of every memory. Try again.

tutorial.text: The bell clock. It stops while you and Pip talk, and runs the rest of the time.
Evidence score. Finds earn points. Wrong answers and hints cost points.
Six Case Pages. Win each room to light one.
Hints cost points. Pip points to the next step.
Your Casebook holds items and notes. Use it to Hold an item.

ui.tutorialGlow: Only the thing that glows gold is the next step. Drag to look around.
missionStory: Hollowmere Academy for the Uncanny is a fog-bound boarding school for children with strange gifts. Legend says a lonely shadow, the Hush, sleeps beneath its chapel.
Three nights ago, on the night of the Black Moon, a student named Ines Vael vanished. The Warden says she simply left. Her raven, Pip, does not believe it.
You are Mirela Crowe, the new student. Pip has asked you to find out what really happened to Ines, before the Midnight Bell rings again tonight.
missionHow: Drag to look around. Pinch or scroll to zoom.
Tap the things that glow gold. They are the next step.
Objects without a glow can be picked up. Tap them.
To use an item: open the Casebook, tap Hold, then tap where it belongs.
Solve each room to win a Case Page and open the way on.
ui.missionRules: You have {time} on the bell clock. A wrong answer costs {wrong} points. A hint costs {hint} points, and each room allows {hints}.
ui.pauseHow: Drag to look around. Tap gold glowing things. Open the Casebook to hold an item.
ui.jigWrong: That piece doesn't fit there. Match the numbers.

lines: Where the road forgets to end, Hollowmere Academy waits in the fog.
Third school this year. Let's see how long this one lasts.
Not long, if you keep talking to yourself.
Pip holds out his leg. A folded note is tied to it.
If I'm gone, give this to whoever arrives next. The bell rang early. Don't believe the answer you're given. Ines.
Tonight the Black Moon returns. When the Midnight Bell rings, whatever isn't remembered is forgotten. That includes her.

mark_key.name: Key Mark
mark_key.slip: The Key opens. It always goes first.

mark_raven.name: Raven Mark
mark_raven.slip: The Raven carries the word. It goes right after the Key.

mark_moon.name: Moon Mark
mark_moon.slip: The Moon sings once the Raven has flown.

mark_thorn.name: Thorn Mark
mark_thorn.slip: The Thorn guards the end. Nothing comes after it.

casePages: The Midnight Bell rang at 11:40, twenty minutes early. The caretaker was told not to ask who ordered it.
Ines was asked to meet someone at the chapel before the bell. The note is signed with one letter: O.
The Hush answers to music. It is lonely, not cruel. The lullaby has five notes.
Mrs Moss saw a tall woman in a grey cardigan cross to the chapel before the bell.
Ines rowed to the chapel shore alone. A second set of narrow, neat boot prints was waiting on the jetty.
A glove marked O.G. and the ring of school gate keys were left at the crypt stairs.

rope.name: Bell rope
rope.desc: Old but strong. Tie it to the gate bell, so the bell can be rung.

string_spool.name: Red string
string_spool.desc: Red string. Use it on the case board to link clues together.

card_photo.name: Ines's photo
card_photo.desc: A girl in a red scarf holding the Warden's lantern. Evidence card.

card_journal.name: Founder's journal
card_journal.desc: A copied page about something that sleeps below the chapel. Evidence card.

card_invitation.name: Invitation
card_invitation.desc: A torn invitation, signed with one letter: O. Evidence card.

card_sketch.name: Chapel sketch
card_sketch.desc: A chapel with a cross drawn by the rose window. Evidence card.

piece1.name: Torn music, piece 1
piece1.desc: Torn sheet music. Put all three pieces together on the music stand.

piece2.name: Torn music, piece 2
piece2.desc: Torn sheet music. Put all three pieces together on the music stand.

piece3.name: Torn music, piece 3
piece3.desc: Torn sheet music. Put all three pieces together on the music stand.

watering_can.name: Watering can
watering_can.desc: Empty. Fill it at the cistern tap, then give it to the Fern.

moon_lantern.name: Moon Lantern
moon_lantern.desc: Gives off moonlight. Give it to the Moon Lily.

bone_pouch.name: Bone-meal pouch
bone_pouch.desc: Bone meal. Give it to the hungry Gulper.

crank.name: Crank handle
crank.desc: An iron handle. It fits the empty socket on the lever panel.

rubbing_paper.name: Rubbing paper
rubbing_paper.desc: Lay it on the worn tomb, then rub charcoal over it.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.desc: Use it on the paper lying on the tomb to lift the carving.

mark_key.name: Key Mark
mark_key.desc: One of the Founder's four Marks. Keep it: you need all four at the chapel.

mark_raven.name: Raven Mark
mark_raven.desc: One of the Founder's four Marks. Keep it: you need all four at the chapel.

mark_moon.name: Moon Mark
mark_moon.desc: One of the Founder's four Marks. Keep it: you need all four at the chapel.

mark_thorn.name: Thorn Mark
mark_thorn.desc: One of the Founder's four Marks. Keep it: you need all four at the chapel.

diary_a.title: Diary page A
diary_a.text: I'm the Warden's apprentice, so I can enter the oldest rooms. The Founder's journal was the strangest thing I found there.

diary_b.title: Diary page B
diary_b.text: The journal talks about a lullaby. I found the sheet music in the music hall. Its five colours match the journal.

diary_c.title: Diary page C
diary_c.text: Someone slipped an invitation under my door: come to the chapel before the bell. It is signed with one letter, O. I drew a map of the chapel and said yes.

poem.title: The rubbing
poem.text: Start where the raven sleeps. The thorn comes next, then the moon. Take the star that stands beside the key. The key opens the stair.

rooms.name: The Rain Gate
rooms.objective: Get through the inner gate to reach the school.
enter: The inner gate is locked, and there's no one here to open it.
Visitors have to ring the gate bell in a set pattern.
Then we need that pattern, and a way to ring the bell.
rooms.hint2: Open the book. Long marks are dashes, short marks are dots.

hotspots.label: Gate plaque

card.title: Gate plaque
card.text: Visitors ring the Visitor's Ring. The pattern is kept in the gatehouse log. Caretaker B. Pell.

lines: Visitors ring the Visitor's Ring. The caretaker keeps the pattern in his gatehouse log.
Bram never lets anyone touch his log. Look at the bell first.
hotspots.objective: Look closely at the gate bell.

hotspots.label: Bell
hotspots.objective: Find a bell rope.
lines: The rope is gone. Without it, no one can ring this bell.
Or the storm ate it. It's a hungry storm.
We need a rope. Let's search around the gatehouse.

hotspots.label: Bell rope
lines: Old, but strong. Open the Casebook, hold the rope, then tap the bell.
hotspots.objective: Tie the rope to the bell. Open the Casebook, tap Hold.

hotspots.label: Bell
hotspots.objective: Find the ring pattern in the gatehouse log, on the desk.

hotspots.label: Logbook

details.title: Four marks
details.text: Four marks: long, long, short, long.

details.title: Bell rung 11:40
details.text: Bell rung 11:40, Black Moon night. Early. Do not ask.

lines: The pattern: long, long, short, long. And a note: the bell rang at 11:40.
The Midnight Bell. Twenty minutes early.
Someone rang it early on purpose. That's our first clue.
hotspots.objective: Ring the bell: long, long, short, long.

hotspots.label: Bell
wrongBank: That's a doorbell for people who want to be ignored.
Check the log. Long means long.
Four marks in a row. Copy them exactly.
lines: One clue down. Someone gave the order to ring that bell early.
Mirela? How wonderful. Come up to the hall when you're settled. And do try not to wander.

rooms.name: Ines's Attic Dorm
rooms.objective: Search Ines's room for her hidden case notes.
enter: This is Ines's room. It's very tidy.
She hid her secrets in plain sight.
Then let's find what she hid.
rooms.hint2: Start with the photo, then follow what each page says came next.

hotspots.label: Corkboard

card.title: Empty corkboard
card.text: Ines pinned her case here, but the board is empty. Her case notes must be hidden somewhere in this room.

lines: An empty case board. Her notes must be hidden nearby.
Try the rug, the book and the pillow. And grab the red string.
hotspots.objective: Search the rug, the book and the pillow. Pick up the red string.

hotspots.label: Red string
lines: Red string. We can link clues on the board with this.

hotspots.label: Rug corner

details.title: Diary page A
details.text: A diary page was hidden under the rug.

lines: A diary page under the rug. Ines was the Warden's apprentice.

hotspots.label: Thick book

details.title: Diary page B
details.text: The book is hollow. A diary page is hidden inside.

lines: That book is far too clean. Nobody ever read it.
It's hollow! A diary page, and cards hidden inside.

hotspots.label: Evidence cards
lines: Five evidence cards. Now we can fill the case board.

hotspots.label: Pillow

details.title: Diary page C
details.text: A page was tucked inside the pillowcase.

lines: An invitation signed 'O'. Someone lured her to the chapel.

hotspots.label: Corkboard
wrongBank: Not that link. Read the diary pages again.
Start with Ines's photo. Which page says what she found first?
Photo, journal, lullaby, invitation, chapel. Link them in that order.
hotspots.objective: Open the trunk.
intro: Five cards and three diary pages. The pages say what came after what.
Start with the photo. Link each card to the one that comes next.

lines: A black feather Mark, and a slip of paper. We'll need them at the end.

rooms.name: The Silent Music Hall
rooms.objective: Find out why this hall is silent.
enter: A huge hall full of chairs, and not a sound.
Don't touch the organ. It has opinions.
rooms.hint2: Put the three pieces on the stand and read the colours left to right.

hotspots.label: Organ nameplate

card.title: Organ nameplate
card.text: Lullaby for the Organ, by Ambrose Hollow. Banned by Music Master L. Fell. Three pieces of the sheet music were torn off and hidden.

lines: The Founder wrote a lullaby, and someone banned it.
It's for the Hush, the shadow under the chapel. Find the three torn pieces.
hotspots.objective: Find the three torn pieces of music.

hotspots.label: Torn piece
lines: A torn piece of sheet music. Two more to find.

hotspots.label: Torn piece
lines: That's all three. Put them together on the music stand.

hotspots.label: Music stand
lines: Five coloured notes: gold, blue, blue, red, green.
Colours instead of notes. The Founder liked puzzles.
hotspots.objective: Find out how to play the lullaby. Check the music box.

hotspots.label: Music box

details.title: Play me as I was written.
details.text: Play me as I was written.

lines: The box says: play me as I was written.
So we play the sheet on the organ.
hotspots.objective: Play the five colours on the organ.

hotspots.label: Organ
wrongBank: That's not a lullaby. That's a complaint.
Check the sheet in your notes. Play it left to right.
Five notes. The first one is gold.
Gold, blue, blue, red, green. Slowly.
lines: A lullaby calms the Hush. Ines must have known that.

rooms.name: The Greenhouse of Thorns
rooms.objective: A thorn vine covers the trapdoor. Find out what the plants need.
enter: Mirela, dear? The greenhouse is no place to be tonight. Why not rest?
She really doesn't want us down here.
rooms.hint2: Read the chart. Each plant needs exactly one thing.

hotspots.label: Care chart

card.title: Plant care chart
card.text: Gulper: bone meal, never water. Moon Lily: moonlight only. Fern: water only. When all three are happy, the Thorn Vine goes to sleep.

lines: One need for each plant: bone meal, moonlight, water.
So we need a pouch, a lantern and a full can.
hotspots.objective: Find the can, the Moon Lantern and the bone-meal pouch.

hotspots.label: Gardener's apron

details.title: Note in the pocket
details.text: Black Moon night. Saw a tall woman in a grey cardigan cross to the chapel before the bell. T. Moss.

lines: The gardener saw a woman in a grey cardigan go to the chapel.
Grey cardigans. That's half the school.
Half. Not all of it. Remember it.

hotspots.label: Watering can
lines: An empty can. Fill it at the cistern tap: hold the can, then tap the tap.

hotspots.label: Gulper
lines: The Gulper gobbled it. That burp means thank you.
The vine is unwinding. There's a trapdoor underneath!
hotspots.objective: Look for the Thorn Mark in the vine.

wrongBank: The Gulper spat on my wing. Wrong plant!
Check the chart. Each plant wants one thing.
Gulper eats bone meal. Lily wants moonlight. Fern wants water.
Pouch to the Gulper, lantern to the Lily, full can to the Fern.

rooms.name: The Black Lake Boathouse
enter: A boat at the bottom of a black lake. Is it Ines's?
She rowed out here at night. I watched.
rooms.hint2: Start at zero, aim for the red line, three pulls. Try plus three, twice.

hotspots.label: Gauge post

card.title: Gauge post
card.text: The boat floats when the water reaches the red line. Each lever changes the water level by its number. You get exactly three pulls.

lines: The red line is where the water must reach.
And only three pulls. Count carefully.
hotspots.objective: Look at the lever panel.

hotspots.label: Lever panel

details.title: Three levers, no crank
details.text: Lever A adds 3. Lever B adds 2. Lever C takes away 1. The socket for the crank handle is empty.

lines: No crank handle. We need to find one.
hotspots.objective: Find a crank handle for the lever panel.

hotspots.label: Crank handle
lines: That should fit the panel. Hold it, then tap the socket.

hotspots.label: Panel socket
hotspots.objective: Pull the levers. Reach the red line in three pulls.

hotspots.label: Levers
wrongBank: Too much water! We're not building an ark.
The red line is 5. Use exactly three pulls.
You start at zero. The water can't go below zero or above six.
Try A, then A again, then C. Add 3, add 3, take away 1.
lines: The name on it says VAEL. This is Ines's boat.

hotspots.objective: Search the boat.

hotspots.label: The boat

details.title: Key on a chain
details.text: A key hangs on a chain under the seat.

details.title: Two sets of footprints
details.text: Small prints from the boat to the chapel shore. And another set waiting there.

lines: Small boot prints lead from the boat to the chapel shore.
And a second, narrow set was waiting there.

hotspots.label: Key Mark
lines: A Mark, hidden in the boat!
The Key Mark. Its slip says the Key always goes first.

rooms.name: The Catacombs
rooms.objective: Find a way past the iron stair gate.
enter: A crypt, under the chapel. Of course.
I'd say something comforting, but I'm a raven in a crypt.
The stairs up are behind that iron gate.
rooms.hint2: Start at the near edge on the raven, then follow the poem one step at a time.

hotspots.label: Founder's tomb

details.title: Worn lines
details.text: The carving is too worn to read. A rubbing might lift it.

lines: The Founder's tomb. The carving is too worn to read.
Rub charcoal over paper to lift it. Find some of each.
hotspots.objective: Find paper and charcoal.

hotspots.label: Charcoal
lines: Charcoal. Lay the paper on the tomb, then rub.

hotspots.label: Tomb
hotspots.toast: The paper lies on the carving.
hotspots.objective: Now use the charcoal on the tomb.

hotspots.label: Tomb
hotspots.objective: Tap the tomb and rub the charcoal over the paper.

hotspots.label: Rubbing
lines: A poem! Raven, thorn, moon, star, key.
It's a path. Follow it across the floor slabs.
hotspots.objective: Cross the floor slabs by following the poem.

hotspots.label: Floor slabs
intro: Start on the raven at the near edge. One step at a time, no diagonals.
The floor cracks and we start again.
wrongBank: The floor cracked. It has a temper.
Start again. Follow the poem one line at a time.
The raven is on the near edge. The thorn is right next to it.
After the moon, take the star that is next to a key.
lines: The gate is open! That floor was rude.
Look. Something is hanging on the hinge.
hotspots.objective: Search the open stair gate.
Search the stairs.

hotspots.label: Ring of keys

details.title: Tag: School Gate Keys
details.text: The tag reads School Gate Keys.

lines: A grey glove stitched O.G., and the school gate keys.
O.G. A tall woman in a grey cardigan...
Everything points to one person. Let's go up to the chapel.

rooms.name: The Hollow Chapel
rooms.objective: Find out who rang the bell early.
enter: The chapel. The air is warm and humming.
That's the rose window. Something is behind it.

hint2.r7_plaque: Read the plaque. It says what the altar wants.
hint2.r7_accuse: Look at the initials, the cardigan and the keys.
hint2.r7_altar: Each Rule Slip says where its Mark goes. Start with the one that says first.
hint2.r7_chimes: The Lullaby Sheet is in your notes.

hotspots.label: Plaque

card.title: Plaque under the altar
card.text: Two truths open the window: who rang the bell early, and the order of the Founder's Marks.

lines: First, who rang the bell. Then, the order of the Marks.
Do the culprit first. I want to see their face.
hotspots.objective: Name the one who rang the bell.

hotspots.label: Accusation
intro: Our Case Pages all point to one person.
lines: You're quicker than I expected, dear.
hotspots.objective: Put the four Marks in order.
warn: No... that's not right. Think carefully, dear. You get one more try.
The lights are flickering. One more mistake and she'll shut us out!
hotspots.loseLine: You accused the wrong person twice. The doors close and the bell rings. Try again.

lines: Please stop. You don't know what it did last time.
I know you locked Ines away.
To keep her safe. I was afraid.
Then let her talk to it.

hotspots.label: Altar
lines: Key, Raven, Moon, Thorn. The Founder loved rules.
hotspots.objective: Play the lullaby on the chimes.
warn: The altar is glowing red! Something below just woke up.
One more wrong Mark and the Hush wakes angry. Read the slips again.
hotspots.loseLine: The Marks were put in the wrong order twice. The Hush rises, and the chapel goes dark. Try again.

hotspots.toast: The window opens. Something hums behind it.

hotspots.label: Chimes
wrongBank: Play the Lullaby Sheet from your notes.
Gold, blue, blue, red, green. Gently.
lines: Best thing I ever heard a shadow do.
It opens like a curtain. Ines steps out of the window light, tired and alive, red scarf in hand. Pip flies to her shoulder.
He was unbearable. Thank you for asking.
I locked it away because I was afraid. I never asked what it wanted.
Staff arrive at the chapel door and quietly lead her out.
Being strange isn't being dangerous. It's being alone.
The Hush hums the lullaby once more.
The Midnight Bell rings twelve strokes. Then a thirteenth.
Ines opens the Founder's last page: a spiral symbol and one line. The Hush was the first. The second sleeps beneath the Black Lake.
Please say we aren't going back to that boathouse.
